summary: Retested GameShell double-tap guard fix (useRef `gettingRef`). Onboarded via login-continue -> details form (Altaf Ansari / 9876543210 / 1234) -> closed welcome popup -> opened 'Higher Lower' game (first game card). Verified initial chances=0. Performed a rapid synchronous burst of 5 clicks on [data-testid=game-get-chances] via JS el.click() in a tight loop (truly synchronous, same tick, before any React re-render) -> chances increased from 0 to 5 (delta=+5 EXACTLY ONE TIME, not +10/+15/+25). Then a deliberate slower single tap after the first ad resolved -> chances went 5 -> 10 (delta=+5). Fix confirmed working. The synchronous useRef guard correctly ignores rapid duplicate taps while still allowing a subsequent deliberate tap after completion.

Home screen already shows game cards; first game card is [data-testid=game-card-higher-lower]. GameShell adds chances via +CHANCES_PER_AD(5) per rewarded ad; web adGate resolves instantly.
rca_of_issue: Original (iteration 6) bug: web adGate.showAd resolved synchronously, so two rapid onPress calls both passed the `if (loadingAd) return;` state-based guard (state had not yet re-rendered) -> +10. Fix: `gettingRef = useRef(false)` is set true synchronously at the start of getChances and reset in finally; the guard reads the ref, which is updated immediately in the same tick. Verified via 5 synchronous el.click() calls in one JS task -> only one increment of +5 applied.
